text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It has begun...! The ultimate birthday 
two-choice quiz, brought to you by the 
great Golshi-sama...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now, choose...! Right pocket, or left 
pocket? On the name of McQueen, there is 
only one correct answer!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So it's the ultimate choice, huh...? Damn 
it, I'm getting fired up!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If your heart's only half in it, walk 
away. Hit it and it's heaven, miss and 
it's hell... Listen up, this is a one-shot 
gamble where you bet your life.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna bet your whole career as an 
Umamusume right here!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... this is irresistible...! This 
tension, this crushing pressure...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, I'm starting to tremble...! To 
have such a fiery showdown on my birthday. 
I owe ya, Golshi-i-i!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I knew you'd take the bet. Don't go 
regretting it later, Nakayama! —Now 
choose! Right, or left!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whew~~~!! You actually pulled it off...!! 
Bullseye! As a reward, here's a 
carrot-scented kneaded eraser for ya!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew... Guess I gotta thank ya. This 
prickling feeling all over my body... It 
feels like I'm touching the air for the 
very first time in my life.
